description: Split long text into numbered 280-character tweets with per-tweet copy.

faqs.a: Text is split greedily at word boundaries, and every tweet stays within 280 characters including its " (i/n)" counter suffix.
The numbering reserves space first (e.g. " (12/12)"), so the final tweet never overflows. If the total grows during splitting, the split is recomputed.
faqs.q: What if adding numbers pushes a tweet over 280?

faqs.a: No. Splitting runs entirely in your browser; your text never leaves your device.

howto: Paste your long text into the box.
Review the numbered tweets — each is 280 characters or fewer.
Copy tweets individually or all at once, separated by blank lines.
title: Twitter Thread Splitter
